scientific_integrity: Exact finite-degree network game theorem with proof of universal local best-response classification; supplementary rational exhaustive enumeration only at bounded graph sizes. The source already states the local threshold and observes cooperative pair patterns, neither claimed new.
scientific_limitations: No statement on positive-mutation stationary dynamics, attraction basins, graphs with degree at least three, isolated vertices, or parameter equality surfaces. Literature-based originality may be revised following independent historical examination.
title: Boundary-sensitive period-three Nash census for a snowdrift game with an individual solution
